lines.sub: I'll do the writing. All you do is say “Yes”.

lines.sub: In “Websites”, open the “Articles” tab and tap “Run articles”. I'll make the topic plan myself.
lines.tts: In Websites, open the Articles tab and tap Run articles. I'll make the topic plan myself.
